producer_field: voltage_v (+ voltage_v_status, voltage_v_age_ms on the bench wire; voltage_status in the delivered schema)
validity_condition: status token == OK AND age within the acquisition period AND the frame is not a register-latency frame
authentic_data_exists: YES in 7-qualified sources: H8-A-180s, H8-B-420s, H8-C-600s-2026-10-31, H8-D-900s, H8-E-1800s, W03-132b-off-envelope, W04-H8C-box-600s-raw
caveat: the committed 600 s CSV publishes the number with an EMPTY status cell, so its voltage values are unqualified

validity_condition: same as voltage; plus the 50 A shunt profile (holding 0x0003) is what the readback recorded
caveat: the PZEM current register lags one integration cycle, so the first post-OFF frame repeats the loaded value; that frame is a latency artefact, not a measurement

validity_condition: status OK; note the delivered CSV builder never emitted a power status column at all
caveat: true power, not V x I; agreement with V x I was checked per frame and stayed inside register quantisation

producer_field: energy_wh ONLY - no status token and no age token exist on the bench wire
validity_condition: NONE PUBLISHED: the value arrives with no validity companion, so it cannot be qualified at all
authentic_data_exists: values exist in H8-A-180s, H8-B-420s, H8-C-600s-2026-10-31, H8-D-900s, H8-E-1800s, W03-132b-off-envelope, W03-pzem-off-2026-10-20, W04-H8C-box-600s, W04-H8C-box-600s-raw but NONE of them are qualified (qualified sources: W03-132b-off-envelope)
caveat: 1 Wh quantum at ~85 W updates roughly every 42 s, so it cannot resolve a short run, and it never decreases inside a boot

producer_field: not published by the device; host-side only
validity_condition: both operands qualified and the frame is DRIVEN
authentic_data_exists: YES for the raw operands; the derived column agrees with reported power inside quantisation
caveat: a consistency check, never a replacement for the power register

source_register: difference of input 0x0004..0x0005 across a run
validity_condition: same boot_id, monotonic counter, run boundaries known
authentic_data_exists: YES: committed 600 s capture 108 -> 122 Wh (delta 14 Wh) against a 14.219 Wh trapezoidal integral of power
caveat: the counter has no validity token; a 14 Wh delta carries a +-1 Wh quantum on each end, so 42 s of run time is the smallest interval it can speak about

validity_condition: power qualified AND the thermal channel OK AND the sensor position frozen
authentic_data_exists: PARTIAL - one 600 s committed run at one duty level only
caveat: duty-resolved power/temperature needs the ladder, which is local-bench only, and W07 repeatability, which is not in this checkout

source_register: input 0x0006 (power factor) / 0x0007 (frequency) on the PZEM-017 - NOT read by this firmware, which reads 6 input registers (cg_modbus.py INPUT_REGISTER_COUNT)
producer_field: absent from every frame of every source
caveat: a DC branch through an IBT-2 makes power factor meaningless anyway; the register was never read and no capture carries it

producer_field: power_validity + electrical_quality + power_beats + power_max_gap_ms in the delivered schema (W05)
validity_condition: requires the delivered schema's liveness counters, which the bench image's line does not emit
authentic_data_exists: NO bench capture carries them; the W05 fixture shows them as a host scenario
caveat: this is the cleanest proof that the bench image and the delivered firmware are different producers of the same physical quantity
